Biosafety level‐3 cryo‐electron tomography of active severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 virions
item.description: 摘要 理解病原病毒在天然、可感染状态下的结构特性对于合理开发抗病毒药物和疫苗至关重要。然而,在生物安全三级(BSL-3)条件下进行冷冻电镜(cryo-EM)研究面临重大挑战。在此,我们在BSL-3设施中建立了并验证了一种高端冷冻电镜工作流程,全面整合了设施设计、防护措施、样品处理、冷冻转移系统和去污染协议。为了展示该工作流程的实用性与可重复性,我们采用冷冻电镜断层扫描技术对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)在天然、活性状态下的结构进行了研究。我们的观察结果证实,未经固定的病毒颗粒表现出与之前在固定或灭活样品中报道的类似多形性特征,验证了这些结构特性是天然特征而非化学固定产生的伪影。此外,还观察到了表面刺突蛋白的空间重新分布。该稳健的BSL-3冷冻电镜工作流程的建立为新兴高危害病原体的结构表征提供了实用蓝图,支持流行病防控、抗病毒药物开发和疫苗发现。

item.title: 删除包膜基因减弱严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2感染通过改变刺突蛋白定位和增加细胞间传播
National flu and COVID-19 surveillance report: 5 November 2026 (week 45) - GOV.UK
item.description: The National Flu and COVID-19 Surveillance Report for 5 November 2026 (week 45) provides an overview of respiratory virus activity in England. It notes that influenza is circulating at low levels, with ED attendances for influenza-like illness slightly above seasonally expected levels. SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) activity has decreased, with confirmed acute respiratory infection (ARI) incidents declining compared to the previous week. RSV activity increased and is at baseline levels. The report highlights data collection challenges, including misclassification of pharmacy vaccinations and incomplete data in weeks 41 and 42, which have been corrected since week 43. A briefing note was issued to inform the NHS about influenza activity exceeding baseline levels. The data is based on the Moving Epidemic Method (MEM) and Mean Standard Deviation (MSD) for defining activity thresholds, with the latter now used for influenza and SARS-CoV-2 laboratory surveillance. The unified sample dataset (USD) is used to calculate SARS-CoV-2 test positivity rates, which decreased slightly in week 44 to 7.6% compared to 8.1% the previous week. Positivity rates remained stable among those aged 85 years and over, at 11.1%.
